    next = No action. Look again when the count grows or a new place appears.
    p.links: topology and address map timeline checks
  p.how: Evidence states what each rule saw and how many ledger records it rests on; the count leads to the records. Checks test the finding against other explanations: "supports" speaks for it, "weakens" speaks against it, "open" could not be tested. Missing lists data the finding did not have.
  ### Rules named in this report
  table.rules
    | rule | grade it gives | fires when
    | R-UE-01 | replace now | an uncorrected error on this DIMM
    | R-ROW-03 | consider replacement | the corrected errors of a row or column fault are rising or came in a recent burst, or its extent is spreading; or a fault covers a bank or more
    | R-SOFT-01 | observe | corrected errors without a growing fault: stray errors at places that did not fail again, or a fault that is neither rising nor spreading

section#s6.sec
  ## 6 Checks against a wrong diagnosis
  p.how: Each finding was tested against causes outside the DIMM: the slot, the channel, the board, and slot names that disagree between sources. "supports" speaks for the finding and "weakens" against it. An open check could not be made from the records; where a person can settle it, the test is listed below the checks.
  section#check-dimm-CPU0_C1.dimm
    ### CPU0_C1 replace now
    #### Checks made from the records
    table.checks
      | result | check
      | open | no other DIMM on this channel: there is nothing to compare with
      | open | no slot move or reseat on record: a cause in the board is not ruled out
      | supports | the other 15 DIMMs of this host have no unconfined errors: a cause in the board is unlikely
      | open | 1,232 errors fall at times when no inventory shows which DIMM was in the slot; they are taken to be this DIMM's
      | weakens | the row is inferred from addresses that lie close together; the platform reports no rows and columns
    #### Tests for a person
    li: Swap the DIMM with one from another channel, or reseat it, and scan again after some days. The ledger then shows whether the errors follow the DIMM, stay in the slot or stop.
    li: Confirm from asset records which DIMM was in the slot at the time of the errors.
    li: Collect records with rows and columns (rasdaemon with the EDAC driver of the platform), so that the fault mode can be determined.
  section#check-dimm-CPU1_D1.dimm
    ### CPU1_D1 observe
    #### Checks made from the records
    p: The records gave no check for this finding.
    #### Tests for a person
    p: No test is open.
